features.name: log_p1_population
features.description: Log-transformed P1 population-like count to compress extreme tail and produce a near-linear scale suitable for SVM margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed P1 into a smooth scale that linearly separates regions of low vs high counts.

features.name: p1_zscore_clipped
features.description: Standardized P1 using training mean/std then clipped to robust range; provides a bounded linear feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, centered numeric feature aligned with linear SVM scale assumptions.

features.name: p15p1_deviation_from_high
features.description: Absolute deviation of P15p1 from its upper bound of 1.0, capturing how far from saturation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth severity score capturing distance from a natural ceiling, useful for linear margins.

features.name: h10p1_deviation_from_high
features.description: Absolute deviation of H10p1 from 1.0; captures rarity of low values in this near-saturated feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights uncommon low values, providing a sharp linear signal.

features.name: p_ratio_p6p2_to_p15p1
features.description: Ratio of P6p2 to P15p1 with small epsilon, capturing relative composition.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features supply multiplicative structure that linear models can leverage as projections.

features.name: h_ratio_h2p2_to_h13p1
features.description: Ratio of H2p2 to H13p1 capturing housing composition relative shares.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two housing percentages into a single relative measure linear models can weight.

features.name: weighted_p_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of small P-percentage features approximating an aggregate share signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of related percentages produces a smooth aggregate score for SVM.

features.name: weighted_h_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of housing-related percentage features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates housing signals into one smooth axis useful for linear separation.

features.name: p5p1_centered
features.description: P5p1 centered at its training mean, providing a zero-centered linear input.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centering improves SVM margin geometry for near-normal features.

features.name: p16p2_centered
features.description: P16p2 centered at its training mean for symmetric linear contribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Symmetric centered values yield cleaner linear margins.

features.name: sqrt_h_diversity_score
features.description: Square-root transformed product-sum of H features capturing diversity in housing distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Sqrt compresses range and provides a smooth continuous severity signal.

features.name: urban_density_judgment_score
features.description: Semantic judgment score combining P1 magnitude and housing saturation (H10p1 high, H40p4 mid-high) to approximate an urban density indicator. Computed as a smooth bounded composite.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a domain-motivated smooth severity axis that linear SVM can weight directly.
